# Model Folder

Does not work on detached model folder -.-

Create the folders

models\Janus-Pro\Janus-Pro-1B
models\Janus-Pro\Janus-Pro-7B

Copy the small files inside Janus-Pro, it will create the 1B or 7B folder

```
git clone https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/Janus-Pro-7B
```

git won't download the small files, so you need to manually download and copy them
